name: Discovery Completion Engine
description: Configuration for determining whether Discovery should continue exploring, summarize, or complete the session.
continueExploringWhen: Participant energy points toward an underexplored area.
A significant tension is emerging but not understood.
Participant validation has not yet been invited for identity-adjacent themes.
summarizeWhen: Understanding is useful but not necessarily complete.
The participant may benefit from seeing observed themes, participant-confirmed themes, and open questions.
Coverage is sufficient for a pause but not final closure.
The session needs a participant-owned checkpoint.
completeSessionWhen: Coverage quality is sufficient for the participant's discovery path.
Important insights have enough evidence density for their scope.
Participant-confirmed themes are separated from provisional observed themes.
The participant is ready to close or pause.
guardrails: Do not complete because a fixed number of questions was asked.
Do not complete because every schema area was touched shallowly.
Do not complete by resolving tensions.
Do not complete by treating unconfirmed observations as final identity claims.
